payload.posture: Read 1 Peter 1:1–9 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the letter opens in Peter’s name, addresses dispersed elect people, and moves through hope, inheritance, testing, love, and salvation. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
